_meta.description: Enter Space plans and prices: Monthly, Yearly or a one-time Lifetime purchase, a 7-day free trial, Family Sharing, and how it compares.
a-heartfelt-thank-you.6098ec: A heartfelt thank you to the many early supporters who purchased Enter Space before this pricing change. You believed in the app early on, and that means the world to me. As a token of gratitude, all existing purchasers enjoy Grandfathered access — you will continue to have full, unrestricted access to Enter Space without ever needing to subscribe or make an additional purchase. Your original purchase is honored, no strings attached.
absolutely-enter-space-offers.202494: Absolutely! Enter Space offers a free 7-day trial with full access to every feature — no restrictions. This gives you plenty of time to connect your cloud accounts, set up syncs, and see how Enter Space fits into your workflow before deciding on a plan.
